question: Which initiative, launched by the Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) under the Ministry of Home Affairs, aims to facilitate rapid action against cybercriminals?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**e-Zero FIR**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **e-Zero FIR** is an initiative launched by the **Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C)** under the **Ministry of Home Affairs**, India.
 
• The platform facilitates the lodging of **First Information Reports (FIRs)** online, even before approaching the police physically.
